records.profile_description: An implementation wrapper preserves an overt directional head, overt perfective 咗, and a final deictic directional element in exact order, as in 入咗嚟 and 落咗去. It contributes no independent Cantonese construction boundary, does not collapse the directional head and deictic into one lexical item, and does not make 嚟 and 去 interchangeable.
records.status_recommendation: migrate to parser_heuristic only through a separate compatibility change; preserve perfective aspect, directional head, and deictic direction as independently typed children

additional_research: The two executable positives are exact directional-head + 咗 + deictic sequences. The sources independently motivate aspect, directional ordering, and deictic contrasts but do not establish PerfectiveDirectionalVP as an atomic Cantonese construction.

source_terms.term: aspect attached to a verbal predicate

records.rationale: PerfectiveDirectionalVP presents a transparent aspect-plus-directional composition as one atomic VP category. DirectionalZoDeicticCompositeWrapper preserves the useful exact-order runtime aggregate while removing it from direct linguistic promotion and requiring independently typed aspect and directional children.
unresolved_blockers: map every directional head and deictic pairing separately
preserve exact ordering and lexical asymmetries
separate motion, path, goal, and deictic relations from perfective aspect
complete compatibility migration before changing the emitted label or status path

records.profile_description: A retired historical wrapper for the weather-specific 停咗雨 bundle. The wrapper duplicated ordinary perfective transitive structure, contributed no independent result-predicate boundary, and must not be restored or used to transfer evidence to broader perfective, weather, or resultative profiles.
records.status_recommendation: remain retired; preserve the UUID, code, alias, and retirement provenance only, with weather semantics and ordinary perfective transitive structure independently typed

additional_research: The retirement archive records zero accepted fixtures and only a zero-weight implementation fallback for the exact 停咗雨 bundle. The historical wrapper duplicated ordinary perfective transitive composition.

records.rationale: PerfectiveObjectResultPredicate encoded one weather-specific lexical bundle as a reusable result-predicate category. The retired UUID remains resolvable as WeatherPerfectiveObjectCompositeWrapper so its provenance is preserved without licensing an independent construction or transferring evidence across weather, transitivity, perfectivity, and result state.
unresolved_blockers: preserve the retired UUID, code, alias, and archive record
do not restore the weather-specific wrapper
keep weather predicates, perfective aspect, object structure, and resultative structure independently typed
do not transfer evidence through the retired aggregate

records.profile_description: A retired historical wrapper for an exact lexical result verb plus perfective 咗 path, represented by 解決咗. The wrapper was shadowed by ordinary perfective composition, contributed no independently sourced result boundary, and must not be restored or generalized to other result predicates.
records.status_recommendation: remain retired; preserve the UUID and historical alias only, and keep lexical result meaning, result complementation, and perfective aspect independently typed

additional_research: The retirement archive records zero accepted fixtures and no complete parser output. The dedicated 解決咗 constructor was consumed by ordinary PerfectiveVP composition and added no independently evidenced boundary.

records.rationale: PerfectiveResultPredicate elevated an exact lexical item plus 咗 into a reusable construction despite being fully shadowed by ordinary perfective composition. LexicalResultPerfectiveCompositeWrapper preserves the retired provenance while preventing evidence transfer from one lexical predicate to the broader resultative or perfective systems.
unresolved_blockers: preserve the retired UUID, code, alias, and retirement provenance
do not restore the exact lexical wrapper
separate lexical result meaning from productive result complementation
do not transfer evidence to broader resultative or perfective profiles

records.profile_description: An implementation wrapper groups independently typed predicates bearing overt perfective 咗 across null-object, overt-object, inner-aspect or result-plus-咗, motion, embedded-clause, and particle-bearing profiles. It preserves overt 咗 and child structure but contributes no single Cantonese construction boundary, inserts no hidden object, and does not equate completion, result, motion, or discourse interpretations.
records.status_recommendation: migrate to parser_heuristic only through a separate compatibility change; preserve overt-object, null-object, inner-aspect, result, motion, embedded, and particle-bearing perfective profiles independently

additional_research: The twenty-one executable positives span bare or null-object V咗, overt-object V咗O, inner-aspect or result-plus-咗 forms, motion predicates, embedded clauses, topic-linked omissions, and sentence-final particles. The sources support several of those profiles but do not make the broad runtime aggregate one indivisible construction.

source_terms.term: verb plus 咗 in questions and answers

records.rationale: PerfectiveVP is too broad to function as one direct construction identity because the runtime label aggregates several independently structured perfective profiles. ZoMarkedPerfectivePredicateWrapper preserves the common overt-咗 implementation layer while removing the umbrella from direct linguistic promotion and protecting the narrower AB30 overt-object identity.
unresolved_blockers: classify every runtime path by predicate type, object realization, inner aspect, motion, embedding, and particle structure
preserve AB30 ZoMarkedPerfectiveObjectVP as a separate narrower language identity
resolve native-speaker variation and lexical restrictions for inner-aspect plus 咗 profiles
complete compatibility migration before changing the emitted label or status path

records.profile_description: An internal question frame preserves an overt proposition host followed by sentence-final biased polar particle 咩, optionally within an independently typed final-particle cluster, as in 去咩, 你食飯咩, and 你去㗎咩. It excludes A-not-A, 有冇, 係咪, final-未, wh, scalar, and other particle-question strategies and cannot fabricate a proposition.
records.status_recommendation: retain parser_heuristic; preserve explicit question subtype metadata and keep other polar-question strategies independently typed

additional_research: All six executable positives contain sentence-final 咩, while the explicit boundaries exclude A-not-A and scalar wh questions. The zero-weight ontology probe records question_subtype biased_sentence_final_me1 and an overt proposition host.

records.rationale: PolarQuestionFrame overstates a broad question family while the actual accepted runtime profile is sentence-final biased 咩. FinalMe1BiasedPolarQuestionFrame names the internal subtype, preserves the overt proposition host and particle cluster, and keeps all other polar strategies separate.
unresolved_blockers: map direct external sources for sentence-final 咩 and its bias profile
preserve particle-cluster ordering and proposition-host boundaries
keep A-not-A, 有冇, 係咪, final-未, and wh strategies independently typed
do not promote the internal frame as a productive Cantonese construction
